benefit_statements.heading: Up to 80% Lower Processing Costs
benefit_statements.body: Automated capture, matching, and approval cut per-invoice cost from the $4–$16 manual range down to a fraction of that — the same reduction shown in your calculator results above.

benefit_statements.heading: 250+ ERPs, Natively Integrated
benefit_statements.body: Yooz connects directly to your existing ERP — no middleware, no rip-and-replace — so AP automation goes live without disrupting the systems your team already runs on.

benefit_statements.heading: Built-In Fraud & Duplicate-Payment Detection
benefit_statements.body: Every invoice is screened for duplicate submissions, vendor-detail changes, and other fraud signals automatically, before it reaches approval — see the fraud-prevention guide below.

benefit_statements.heading: Capture-to-Approval, Fully Automated
benefit_statements.body: From invoice receipt through matching, routing, and approval, Yooz removes the manual keying and email-thread approvals that drive the 22–35 day cycle times above.

AI has made these attacks more convincing than ever. This guide shows finance leaders how to spot the red flags early and close the gaps before someone finds them.
